inputSchema.description: Request model for listing CustomDimensions on a property.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of resources to return. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListCustomDimensions call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The property for which to list CustomDimensions. Format: properties/{property_id}
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: AnalyticsadminPropertiesCustomdimensionsListRequest

customDimensions.description: Array of CustomDimension objects representing the listed custom dimensions
customDimensions.title: Custom Dimensions

nextPageToken.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results. Empty if there are no more results
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

description.description: Description of the dimension. Max 150 characters
description.title: Description

disallowAdsPersonalization.description: If true, marks dimension as NPA and excludes from ads personalization
disallowAdsPersonalization.title: Disallow Ads Personalization

displayName.description: Display name for this custom dimension in the Analytics UI. Max 82 characters
displayName.title: Display Name

parameterName.description: Immutable tagging parameter name for this custom dimension
parameterName.title: Parameter Name

scope.description: Dimension scope. Values: DIMENSION_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED, EVENT, USER, ITEM
scope.title: Scope
